svg.title: Security Observatory by FortMilo — reference architecture
svg.desc: Design constraints. Three inviolable constraints sit above the architecture: no automated FortMilo or third-party data egress; no remediation; no false-clean signal. The architecture is designed around all three. Business use. A Salesforce customer organisation contains a security reviewer/admin role and a review-evidence-and-decide activity. Security posture evidence supports CISO, risk and compliance stakeholders. Manual remediation is drawn separately and marked out of scope: the Observatory issues no change to the org. Trust boundary. A dashed technical boundary marks the subscriber Salesforce org runtime. Product execution, configuration reads and Observatory-owned evidence storage sit inside it; business users and decision-making remain outside the runtime boundary. Product architecture. The Security Observatory package reads org configuration and metadata without modifying those Salesforce sources. Four product capabilities execute in sequence: collect configuration evidence, classify evidence state, map to SBS control references, and present and export evidence. The product writes sanitised Observatory-owned evidence, findings and CSV export artefacts inside the subscriber org and reads the SBS control registry. Salesforce runtime. The Salesforce platform provides the subscriber-org runtime. Apex, async queueables, SOQL and a Named Credential execute scans, authenticated same-org Tooling API self-callouts and evidence persistence. In-org execution/storage and Tooling API self-callout services support the product. Boundary crossings. Two connections cross the technical runtime boundary: the evidence service supports the business review activity, and a customer-initiated CSV data flow runs from the export capability to that activity. Only the CSV data flow carries exported evidence.
svg.text: Reference architecture · Salesforce-native security evidence architecture · website publication candidate
STATUS: REFERENCE VIEW — NOT A RELEASE STATEMENT
NATIVE · READ-ONLY ASSESSMENT · NO AUTOMATED THIRD-PARTY EGRESS
No automated FortMilo or third-party egress
No evidence is sent to FortMilo or non-Salesforce services
Assessment only — the org owner decides and acts
Absence of evidence is never rendered as safe
Implemented by the architecture below — supporting links omitted for legibility
Who operates the Observatory, who consumes its evidence, and who acts on it
Structure: customer organisation, reviewer role and review activity
Observatory issues no change to the org
SUBSCRIBER SALESFORCE ORG — TECHNICAL TRUST BOUNDARY
Technical runtime boundary; business users remain outside it
Reference architecture; delivered coverage is release-specific
Representative surfaces; coverage varies by release.
Salesforce package · executes inside the subscriber org
States and causes — no FortMilo-generated score or verdict
Structure: capabilities are grouped inside Security Observatory · other containment is visual only
No business-record content, access tokens, session identifiers, certificate bodies, secrets or raw IP addresses are retained.
DATA FLOW · Customer-initiated CSV evidence — the only data-bearing crossing
The subscriber org runtime that executes the scans and stores the evidence — FortMilo operates no infrastructure
Runtime structure: Salesforce Platform hosts Apex, SOQL and Named Credential execution
